name: Marketplace
eComp: +1 influence upon a successful trade with another player.
eVisitO: +1 resource of any kind upon a successful Trade.

name: Housing
eVisitX: Take a Build Action on any tile. This uses your Build Action for the turn.
eVisitO: You may take a Build Action. If it is your turn, take an additional Build Action.

name: Farm
eComp: +1 influence and +1 influence per adjacent farm

name: Pendantmaker
eVisitX: You may pay 4 crystals to receive a sigil.

name: Stoas
eVisitO: +1 advantage roll. (You can spend these on the same roll)

name: Baths
eComp: Place a floodplain. +1 influence for each adjacent water building, floodplain, or lake.
eVisitX: Change one plains into a floodplains.
eVisitO: you may dry or flood one tile

name: Aqueduct
eComp: Gain 1 influence per lake or floodplain on the map. (You choose)
eVisitX: Re-Populate or Replenish one adjacent Resource Tile, then Gather.
eVisitO: Take from the stockpile half of what the visitor Gathered.

name: Amphitheater
eVisitX: Trade a sigil with the stockpile. They do not have to be the same kind.

name: Sewers
eComp: Add three sewer tiles. One below this tile and two adjacent tiles. +4 influence
eVisitX: Enter the sewers. While in the sewers, take a Cast action instead of an Event or Gather.

name: Basilica
eComp: Adjust your alignment to whatever you want. Your alignment adjusts give you +1 influence.
eVisitX: Adjust alignment by 2. you may cast an additional spell this turn.
eVisitO: You may adjust your alignment by 1.

name: Hippodrome
eComp: get +1 influence per layer from now on. +4 influence.
eVisitX: Engage in a duel: display your most impressive, most powerful, and most beautiful spells.
eVisitO: +1  vote on objection during the duel
